commands: echo '=== Cook Smart Amazon Linux Node.js Deployment ==='
echo 'Step 1: Install Node.js using Amazon Linux extras (compatible version)'
sudo amazon-linux-extras install -y nodejs14 || echo 'nodejs14 not available, trying yum'
sudo yum install -y nodejs npm || echo 'yum install failed'
echo 'Step 2: Try alternative - install from EPEL'
echo 'Step 4: If Node.js still not available, use existing if present'
which node || echo 'No node binary found'
echo 'Step 6: Check if we can proceed without Node.js (pre-built dist)'
ls -la dist/ || echo 'No dist directory found'
echo 'Step 7: If Node.js available, install PM2 and proceed'
pm2 delete all || echo 'No existing PM2 processes'
echo 'Node.js not available - cannot proceed with backend deployment'
